The bus pulls up. I check through the door to make sure people aren't approaching the front to block my ingress. The coast is clear, so I hop up and start dumping change into the ticket box. The driver— a portly white gentleman wearing mirror shades, if you'd like to know— says to me, "chill out, bro."

Chill out, bro‽ I look at him, still ramming pennies into the slot, and ask for clarification. He explains: there are people "trying to get off." This must have been an admonition not to fuck on the bus! There must have been a rash of people trying to get each other off, as I checked specifically to ensure I wouldn't be blocking anybody before getting on, and saw that THERE PLAINLY WERE NOT ANY PEOPLE TRYING TO GET OFF THE FUCKING BUS.

Of course, people wouldn't get off at the front if the back doors actually worked. Every week there's some new jank-ass mechanism to open the back door that functions just as poorly as last week's. Touch the spot. Wave your hand at the sensors. Click your bootheels together and shout SIEG HEIL while heil-fiving the door. The actual method is to yell to the driver and hope they don't simply abduct you to the next stop.
